as_told.title: Government has held secret physics since the end of World War II

plain: The idea is that since the 1940s the US government has been doing secret research in fundamental physics, the basic science of matter and energy, and that this work has gone beyond what the public knows. The national security analyst Matthew Pines says it on the show as his own reading: "it's very clear to me that US government has been conducting secret fundamental physics research." James Valor, of Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to summon UFOs, tells Michels he agrees with the mathematician Eric Weinstein that the government has "top secret physics, knowledge and science," probably since "at least" the end of the Second World War. Both give it as an opinion and name no document. If they are right, the science the public is taught would be behind what is kept in secret.
